propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs for stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 remain stuck at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours because they omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f, which reverted per-blob lazy-fetching during blobless partial clone; without the fix, ~40 sequential git-fetch RPCs for missing blobs take ~2.1 hours, confirmed by GIT_TRACE2_EVENT runtime trace and 747f regression oracle.

.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml test job lacks timeout-minutes, so GitHub applies the 360-minute default instead of the 10–16 minute documented normal duration, preventing automatic job failure and leaving hung workers stuck until manual cancellation.

Gerrit 1129 PS3 contains a new defect in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_transport.py::test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract where FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignores startAt/maxResults pagination parameters and returns the same non-empty issue list forever, causing _paged_search to loop infinitely and timeout in ~3 seconds.

Manual clearing of stuck runs by requeue burst occupies 16 matrix job slots and queues subsequent runs, causing operational friction because the underlying timeout configuration allows unlimited job duration.

Affected stale patchsets derive from ancestor fde6baae which predates 96a0d5c3f; contemporaneous run 30668764517 with 96a0d5c3f ancestry completed all matrix cells successfully in 6–17 minutes, proving the 747f fix is both necessary and sufficient for the primary hang.

Post-fix verification confirms: workflow timeout added to 60 minutes, FakeJiraClient pagination fixed to slice results by startAt/maxResults, 1129 PS4 merged, 1130 PS5 rebase completed in 16m24s with normal test failures unrelated to hangs.
